Package Description
org.drip.state.municipal
Municipal Latent State Curve Estimator
  • Classes in org.drip.state.municipal used by org.drip.state.municipal
    Class Description
    KalotayWilliamsFabozzi
    KalotayWilliamsFabozzi implements the Controller of the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    KalotayWilliamsFabozziPeriod
    KalotayWilliamsFabozzi implements a Period in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    KalotayWilliamsFabozziPeriodState
    KalotayWilliamsFabozziPeriodState holds the Period's Inferred State Metrics.
    ProxyBond
    ProxyBond implements a Bond Proxy to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    ProxyBondSensitivity
    ProxyBondSensitivity contains the Duration and the Convexity of a Bond using the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    ZeroVolatilityPeriodState
    ZeroVolatilityPeriodState augments the Period's Inferred State Metrics with the Market Yield.
